Dear Sirs, 
In continuation to our letter dated October 28, 2026 regarding intimation of Investors / Analyst 
conference call to discuss operational and financial performance of the Company for Q2 FY27, we 
would like to inform you that the audio recording of the said call has been uploaded on the Company’s 
website. This can be accessed via the following link under Investor Information – Audio Transcript tab 
on the Company’s website: 
 
Link: https://www.anandgroupindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/10048440.mp3 
 
We request you to take the above information on record and acknowledge the receipt. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Gabriel India Limited
